Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning dental insurance for enlisted members of the Washington national guard.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to dental insurance for enlisted members of theWashington national guard; and adding a new section to chapter 38.24RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All enlisted members of grade E1 through E5 of the Washingtonnational guard who enlist after August 1, 2014, for a minimum period ofthree years, are eligible for additional compensation from the state ofWashington in the form of a payment of the monthly premium for theeligible member for a qualified premiumbased dental plan provided foractive duty service members, national guard and reserve members, andother eligible persons. The state of Washington shall select thequalified premiumbased dental plan that applies pursuant to thissection. (2) The compensation described in subsection (1) of this sectionmust be paid for the period of the enlistment.
